theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ h : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) h ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (h x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (h x - g x) ≤ δ
